list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE SpanKind = 'Server' AND ServiceName != 'PostgreSQL_Server' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() / ($__toTime - $__fromTime) AS rps FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) HAVING count() > 0

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95 FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) HAVING count() > 0

defaults.noValue: No instrumented service sends spans yet

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, Timestamp, Duration FROM otel.otel_traces
                  WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)),
     db AS (SELECT TraceId, ParentSpanId, sum(Duration) AS db_ns FROM otel.otel_traces
            WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
            GROUP BY TraceId, ParentSpanId)
SELECT sum(db.db_ns) / sum(r.Duration) AS share
FROM requests AS r LEFT JOIN db ON db.TraceId = r.TraceId AND db.ParentSpanId = r.SpanId
HAVING count() > 0

panels.title: Where the time goes

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, Timestamp, Duration FROM otel.otel_traces
                  WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)),
     db AS (SELECT TraceId, ParentSpanId, sum(Duration) AS db_ns FROM otel.otel_traces
            WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
            GROUP BY TraceId, ParentSpanId)
SELECT $__timeInterval(r.Timestamp) AS time,
       avg(r.Duration - db.db_ns) / 1e6 AS app, avg(db.db_ns) / 1e6 AS database
FROM requests AS r LEFT JOIN db ON db.TraceId = r.TraceId AND db.ParentSpanId = r.SpanId
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Average request time split into database client spans and everything else.

targets.rawSql:
WITH requests AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, Timestamp, Duration FROM otel.otel_traces
                  WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)),
     db AS (SELECT TraceId, ParentSpanId, sum(Duration) AS db_ns FROM otel.otel_traces
            WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
            GROUP BY TraceId, ParentSpanId),
     t AS (SELECT TraceId, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(Timestamp)) AS ms FROM otel.otel_traces
           WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY TraceId)
SELECT r.TraceId AS trace, r.Timestamp AS started, round(r.Duration / 1e6, 1) AS ms,
       round(100 * db.db_ns / r.Duration) AS db_pct,
       t.ms - 120000 AS from_ms, t.ms + r.Duration / 1e6 + 120000 AS to_ms
FROM requests AS r LEFT JOIN db ON db.TraceId = r.TraceId AND db.ParentSpanId = r.SpanId
LEFT JOIN t ON t.TraceId = r.TraceId
ORDER BY r.Duration DESC LIMIT 20

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / count() AS errors
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pg.SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] AS query_id, pg.ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster,
       substring(any(pg.SpanName), 1, 100) AS statement, count() AS executions,
       round(sum(pg.Duration) / 1e9, 2) AS total_s
FROM otel.otel_traces AS pg
WHERE pg.ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server' AND $__timeFilter(pg.Timestamp)
  AND pg.SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] NOT IN ('', '0')
  AND match(pg.SpanName, '^(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|WITH)')
  AND pg.TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '$service' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp))
GROUP BY query_id, cluster ORDER BY total_s DESC LIMIT 20
